title: The Sanctity of Rhythm
subtitle: Enoch's astronomy, the numbers 3, 7 and 12, and reclaiming a living sense of time.
summary: We treat time as a commodity on a clock. The Astronomical Book of Enoch, the old base-12 and base-60 numbers, the patterns of 3, 7 and 12, music, and the evening-first day of Genesis all point to time as something living, and to ways of getting that rhythm back.
aiNote: Rough draft for review: the Verses Across team's own essay, edited and fact-checked with AI. 1 Enoch is quoted from R. H. Charles's public-domain translation on this site, and the Bible from the King James Version. The number symbolism is the essay's own reflection, not a scientific claim.
